about_the_game:
From bedroom workshop to board game empire!

In Tabletop Inc., you start small — running a tiny tabletop game company from your own bedroom. Choose your genre and theme, develop your mechanics, and bring your ideas to life one piece at a time.

Design it, box it, ship it — then watch the reviews (and money) roll in.

[hr][/hr]
🛠️ Build & Design
  • Pick from a wide range of genres and themes — from medieval fantasy to sci-fi and party games to strategy epics.
  • Balance core mechanics, player experience, and visual design to create the perfect tabletop experience.
  • Assemble game boxes yourself with boards, miniatures, cards, and components.

📈 Grow Your Business
  • Sell your games and track sales & reviews.
  • Pay your bills, manage your budget, and hire your friends to help expand production.
  • Unlock R&D upgrades — from premium components to brand-new genres and themes.
  • Create merchandise from your most popular titles.

🏠 Cozy Tycoon Experience
  • Upgrade your humble workshop into a full creative studio.
  • Enjoy a relaxing isometric management sim where every decision counts.
  • No two games you make will be the same — experiment, iterate, and perfect your craft.

Will your next release become the hottest game night hit — or end up in the bargain bin?

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 12.04, SteamOS (Proton-8 Recommended)
  • Processor: 1.7 GHz Processor
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 8 or higher, ATI X1600 or higher, or Intel HD 3000 or higher
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: Proton-8 Recommended

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mac OS X 10.6 or above
  • Processor: Apple Silicon M1 (M2 and M3) or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1280x720 minimum resolution, OpenGL 2.0 Support, and recommended dedicated graphics card with 128 MB of RAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: M1, M2, M3 Silicon Mac & ARM Supported
